title: KASPER
subtitle: AZUR SQUADRON // 2ND TFS
lore: Wanted internationally under the pretext of investigation for war crimes and conspiracy, KASPER is a old friend of DONUT and a master of Belkan espionage.
Do not let her status fool you however, as her skill in the air is deadly in its own right. Enough so to where she can still put up good numbers despite preferring to fly a very outdated airframe.
